description: This file is an Objective-C source code file implementing a utility to upload minidump files to a server via HTTP multipart POST request. It defines functions for setting up options, performing the upload, and handling command-line arguments.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Performs the upload of the minidump file to the specified URL with given product and version parameters.

methods.name: Usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the command-line utility.

methods.name: SetupOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set up the options structure with product, version, minidump path, and upload URL.
